class.name: SteamItemInstance
class.brief_description: A detached item instance and stack state from Steam.
class.description: Snapshot quantities and flags describe the item at the time Steam returned it. The flags carry Steam's numeric mask, including bit [code]1[/code] for account-locked items and bit [code]512[/code] when Steam reports consumption.

method.name: get_instance_id
method.description: Returns the opaque instance ID in unsigned decimal form.

method.name: get_definition_id
method.description: Returns the published definition associated with this instance.

method.name: get_quantity
method.description: Returns the current stack quantity reported by Steam.

method.name: get_flags
method.description: Returns the Steam item status and action confirmation bits.
